items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I don't know what happened to Jean Eldridge after that band broke up.

ctx.x: Jean Eldridge was a very fine girl. I think she would've been as big as Billie Holiday, if she had stuck with her profession. She was a great singer and she
just disappeared. I don't know what happened to Jean Eldridge after that band broke up.
